title: App Builder: an app.id outside ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$ is refused on save (typed 400) and by the loader, and the skin selector value is escaped so the custom-CSS scoping cannot be escaped

criteria.given: an app document whose id contains characters outside the allowed set (the issue's `"]{}` breakout payload)
criteria.then: the server rejects the save with a typed 400 (VALIDATION_ERROR, field id) and the UI loader refuses the document, so it is never rendered
the attribute-selector value is escaped, so the skin stylesheet — and the sanitised customCss — can contain no rule outside the app's scope; a vitest covers the issue's payload and asserts it

criteria.given: an app whose id is generated (letters, digits, _ and -, at most 64 chars)
criteria.then: the save answers 200 and the document loads back unchanged
